sentences.text: Vescimonas coprocola was proposed as a novel genus and species for a strain isolated from human faeces, with type strain MM50.
The isolates in that description were Gram-stain-negative, obligately anaerobic, non-spore-forming, non-motile rods placed in the family Ruminococcaceae.
A shotgun metagenomic study comparing people with major depressive disorder and controls reported Vescimonas coprocola among the top four taxa enriched in the controls.
